changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.comment: Adding new region column for DatabaseServer
changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[DatabaseServer]','Region') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[DatabaseServer] ADD Region varchar(250) Constraint DF_DatabaseServer_Region default('<unknown>') not null END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('[dbo].[DatabaseServer]','Region') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[DatabaseServer] DROP DF_DatabaseServer_Region ALTER TABLE [dbo].[DatabaseServer] DROP COLUMN Region END
